toolObservationsReported: tools/trace-answers.py's self-consistency check keys on TASK ids only. A CHALLENGE given two statuses in one document is invisible to it, and two of this pass's twelve third-class instances are exactly that. Queued as T-183; not implemented here because tools/ was in use by a sibling agent.
The status vocabulary does not contain 'in flight'. Three passages asserted T-139 was in flight while TASKS.md had it DONE since iteration 16, and queue_status reported 0 stale throughout.

The OPEN word list matches inside ordinary prose: 'a list of open questions', 'can reopen the flat tile' and 'CH-0114, open' each manufactured a false contradiction against a task ID in the same sentence. Each was real drift-checker behaviour working as designed and each cost one rewording; a checker that is one-sided on purpose (C-0088 guard 2) pays for it in author friction, which is the right trade and is worth recording.
